season.evidence: Search: Mountaineers lists Jul-Sep for the neighbouring Vasiliki Tower; stored window is late June to September, highway reopening gating access (May 2025 ascents were on snow). Logged ascents May 5, Jul 1, Aug 2, Sep 1.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Only one route on the peak and the line is the Burgundy Col approach to the summit (6 m from pin, summited), but it was May 2, over a month before the Jun window, with snow from 6,200 ft. Start is 295 m from our trailhead pin; no trailhead coordinate could be confirmed from a fetched page, so no pin move.

notes: If the owner accepts a May 2 ascent as within season, 2830370 would be the track (kind oneway, 295 m / 308 m from pin), but the trailhead pin is unconfirmed. Nominatim and SummitPost fetches returned nothing usable.
